articles.title: KSP CPC answer key 2026 to be released shortly at ksp-recruitment.in; know objection process and next important dates

articles.title: MHT CET CAP Round 1 allotment 2026 released at cetcell.mahacet.org; candidates must complete seat acceptance by August 5
